title: "Integration: Quality Control"
format: html

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: hide
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
#| message: false
# Integration QC
# Get UMAP files
merged_umap_file <- dir(
  "integration_qc",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\.merged\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]
integrated_umap_file <- dir(
  "integration_qc",
  pattern = "^.*\\.umap\\.integrated\\.png$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)[1]

# Get cohort ID
cohort_id <- gsub("^integration_qc\\/(.*)\\.umap\\.merged\\.png$", "\\1", merged_umap_file)
```

#### Dataset name: `{r} cohort_id`

### Merged (unintegrated) dataset UMAP

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat(paste0('<img src="', merged_umap_file, '" alt="merged dataset umap: ', cohort_id, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
```

### Integrated dataset UMAP

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
cat(paste0('<img src="', integrated_umap_file, '" alt="integrated dataset umap: ', cohort_id, '" width="100%">\n\n'))
```
